editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends are just trying to film a cool web series about your hometown, but you accidentally stumble onto a nightmare. You follow three friends who start noticing that their neighbors are acting really weird. Soon, you find out the truth: creatures are killing people and replacing them with perfect clones. It starts off feeling like a fun project between pals, but it quickly turns into a scary race to figure out who is actually human and who is a monster hiding in plain sight. The vibe is a mix of a small-town mystery and a creepy sci-fi flick that keeps you guessing.

What really works here is how the tension builds up. The acting feels natural, and the twists keep you on your toes. While some of the special effects are a bit simple, the story makes up for it by being genuinely spooky. If you love movies where you can't trust anyone, you should definitely check this one out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture possible, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the creepy details. It is a great pick for a weekend binge.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the creatures have almost completely taken over the town. The main characters try to fight back, but the twist is that the clones are too good at blending in. One of the friends realizes that even the people they trusted might already be replaced. The movie wraps up on a scary note, leaving you wondering if anyone is actually safe and if the humans have any chance of winning.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about imposters and alien takeovers.
